## 6. Automation Path

- **Trigger**: after editing `skills/<x>/SKILL.md`, run `.\.trae\scripts\build-skill-inventory.ps1 -Apply`
- **CI hook**: `validate-codex-capabilities.ps1` can detect skill count delta and prompt rerun
- **Fail-safe**: `-CheckOnly` runs 7 AC checks without writing
- **Idempotent**: rerunning yields identical output (modulo skills/ or catalog.json changes)

## 7. Usage

```powershell
# default (dry-run, AC report only)
.\.trae\scripts\build-skill-inventory.ps1

# actually write
.\.trae\scripts\build-skill-inventory.ps1 -Apply

# check only (no write, no catalog load)
.\.trae\scripts\build-skill-inventory.ps1 -CheckOnly
```
